name: IP as Logo
summary: Agent skill that writes image-generation prompts for simple, cute IP mascot characters.
description: Guides an agent through a short discovery step, three proposed directions and a six-candidate batch of rounded mascot images with two character colors and one solid background. Installs with the Agent Skills CLI and requires a top-tier image model such as GPT Image 2 or Nano Banana Pro.
contains: one silhouette from roughly 4-7 shapes, readable at 32x32
three directions proposed, then six candidates in one batch
two IP base colors plus one solid background color
targets GPT Image 2, Seedance 5.0 Pro, Nano Banana Pro or Nano Banana 2
installs through the Agent Skills CLI with --global option
free ready-made logos on its companion website, free for commercial use
